title: Samsung Galaxy S27: Is It Copying the iPhone Dynamic Island?
description: 9to5Google says Samsung may soon copy the iPhone's Dynamic Island, and that it actually looks good. Source: 9to5Google This is a short news summary.
narration: Samsung may soon copy the iPhone's Dynamic Island. That is what 9to5Google is reporting. 9to5Google says the Samsung version actually looks good. The outlet showed it off in a video. And Forbes reports that early software reveals an iPhone-style overhaul. The phone in question is the Galaxy S27. Forbes is already covering its release date and that early software. For now, this is just a rumor. 9to5Google is only saying Samsung might do it soon, not that it will. Apple already has this on the iPhone. The big question is whether Samsung actually follows through with it. Subscribe for more daily tech news.
